effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [Free] trait, gain 1 memory.
[On Play] Activate 1 of the following effects:
・You may play 1 [Veemon] from your hand without paying the cost.
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into [ExVeemon] in the hand without paying the cost.
